## Highlights
### New
- Choose how the address field shows a page's address in Appearance: on two lines, on one line, or just the site. - Super Copy, on by default, copies and shares links without known trackers. It follows supported redirect links to their destination, applies AdGuard's URL Tracking filter and Crest's own rules, and shortens Amazon product links. Selecting the address and copying it keeps everything.
### Improved
- The sidebar narrows to 164 points, about as narrow as Arc's. In a narrow sidebar, Forward folds away to keep clear of the window's buttons, and Copy URL makes room for the address.
### Fixed
- The Start Page and its tab now show the app icon you chose instead of the default one. - Copy URL and Site Controls sit side by side in the address field instead of on top of each other.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
